## Accelerating Access to 
## Affordable and Innovative Medicines
## 
## Our latest launches that bring innovative solutions to patients across the world

[Toripalimab-image]

###### Toripalimab

The first immunotherapy approved by major global regulators for recurrent or metastatic
nasopharyngeal carcinoma (RM-NPC). In India, it introduces immuno-oncology as a first-line treatment
for RM-NPC in combination with chemotherapy.

[Read More][66]
[Bevacizumab-image]

###### Bevacizumab

Our first biosimilar approved and launched in the UK. It is a treatment for several types of cancer,
including colorectal, lung, brain, kidney, cervical, and ovarian cancers. Bevacizumab works by
blocking a protein called VEGF, slowing the growth and spread of cancer.

[Read More][67]
[Lenacapavir-image]

###### Lenacapavir

A long-acting, USFDA-approved treatment for HIV-1 infection. Our work with Lenacapavir supports our
goal to expand HIV treatment and prevention, especially in high-burden regions. We aim to
manufacture and commercialise Lenacapavir across 120 countries, in partnership with Gilead Sciences.

[Read More][68]

## Helping Patients Navigate Their Treatment Journey

[Learn More][69]
[Vega Club]

#### Vega Club

A patient support program where gastroenterologists help people with ulcerative colitis better
understand and manage Inflammatory Bowel Disease through personalised guidance on diet, exercise,
and stress.

[betaCare]

#### betaCare

An initiative in Germany providing useful health information to patients. It also offers certified
online courses to improve patient care, and help them navigate treatment and the healthcare system.

[Joint Health Revolution]

#### Joint Health Revolution

Sessions developed for individuals with osteoarthritis, designed to guide them in understanding
effective joint care. These doctor-led sessions help patients learn about the right exercises,
healthy habits and ways to manage pain, and stay active.

[Learn More][70]

## From Doing Less Harm to Maximal Good
## 
## We continue working towards reducing our environmental footprint, addressing ecological risks
## from our operations, and are progressing towards carbon neutrality

[Learn More][76]
[Water]

#### Environment

###### Water

By implementing initiatives such as wastewater recovery, grey water use, and more, we reduced
freshwater consumption by ~70,000 KL from April to September 2023.

[Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction image]

###### Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction

By conducting site-level climate risk assessments and improving supplier engagement by sustainable
procurement, we identified key vulnerabilities and reduced Scope 3 emissions intensity by 31% since
FY2023.

[Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency image]

###### Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency

By implementing cost improvement projects and strengthening site-level waste checks, we achieved
20-22% reduction in waste across 9 high-volume products. 

[Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy image]

###### Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy

By replacing fossil fuels with biofuels in boilers and expanding solar, wind, and hybrid energy use,
we reduced Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 33% vs FY2023. Energy-saving initiatives also helped avoid
8,073 tonnes of CO₂ and saved 7.75 million kWh in FY2025.

[Loxoprofen]

###### Loxoprofen

[Read More][63]
[Beyfortus®]

###### Beyfortus®

A novel drug launched in India to protect newborns and infants from lung infections caused by
Respiratory Syncytial Virus in the first season of exposure.

[Read more][64]
[Colozo®]

###### Colozo®

A USFDA-approved option for Chronic Idiopathic Constipation in adults, which acts on gut receptors
to help support normal digestive function.

[Read more][65]

## Accelerating Access to 
## Affordable and Innovative Medicines
## 
## Our latest launches that bring innovative solutions to patients across the world

[Toripalimab-image]

###### Toripalimab

The first immunotherapy approved by major global regulators for recurrent or metastatic
nasopharyngeal carcinoma (RM-NPC). In India, it introduces immuno-oncology as a first-line treatment
for RM-NPC in combination with chemotherapy.

[Read More][66]
[Bevacizumab-image]

###### Bevacizumab

Our first biosimilar approved and launched in the UK. It is a treatment for several types of cancer,
including colorectal, lung, brain, kidney, cervical, and ovarian cancers. Bevacizumab works by
blocking a protein called VEGF, slowing the growth and spread of cancer.

[Read More][67]
[Lenacapavir-image]

###### Lenacapavir

A long-acting, USFDA-approved treatment for HIV-1 infection. Our work with Lenacapavir supports our
goal to expand HIV treatment and prevention, especially in high-burden regions. We aim to
manufacture and commercialise Lenacapavir across 120 countries, in partnership with Gilead Sciences.

[Read More][68]

## Helping Patients Navigate Their Treatment Journey

[Learn More][69]
[Vega Club]

#### Vega Club

A patient support program where gastroenterologists help people with ulcerative colitis better
understand and manage Inflammatory Bowel Disease through personalised guidance on diet, exercise,
and stress.

[betaCare]

#### betaCare

An initiative in Germany providing useful health information to patients. It also offers certified
online courses to improve patient care, and help them navigate treatment and the healthcare system.

[Joint Health Revolution]

#### Joint Health Revolution

Sessions developed for individuals with osteoarthritis, designed to guide them in understanding
effective joint care. These doctor-led sessions help patients learn about the right exercises,
healthy habits and ways to manage pain, and stay active.

[Learn More][70]

## From Doing Less Harm to Maximal Good
## 
## We continue working towards reducing our environmental footprint, addressing ecological risks
## from our operations, and are progressing towards carbon neutrality

[Learn More][76]
[Water]

#### Environment

###### Water

By implementing initiatives such as wastewater recovery, grey water use, and more, we reduced
freshwater consumption by ~70,000 KL from April to September 2023.

[Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction image]

###### Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction

By conducting site-level climate risk assessments and improving supplier engagement by sustainable
procurement, we identified key vulnerabilities and reduced Scope 3 emissions intensity by 31% since
FY2023.

[Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency image]

###### Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency

By implementing cost improvement projects and strengthening site-level waste checks, we achieved
20-22% reduction in waste across 9 high-volume products. 

[Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy image]

###### Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy

By replacing fossil fuels with biofuels in boilers and expanding solar, wind, and hybrid energy use,
we reduced Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 33% vs FY2023. Energy-saving initiatives also helped avoid
8,073 tonnes of CO₂ and saved 7.75 million kWh in FY2025.

[Learn More][77]

## Established in the year 1990, Divi’s is a leading manufacturer of Active Pharmaceutical
## Ingredients offering high quality products to over 100 countries.

[Icon]

##### Manufacturing

Divi’s manufactures Generic APIs, Intermediates, and Nutraceutical Ingredients, and offers Custom
Synthesis of APIs to Big Pharma, providing a competitive advantage throughout the entire product
lifecycle.

[Icon]

##### Quality

Divi’s believes in meeting or exceeding the quality levels set by the customer and strives to adhere
to stringent global regulatory standards.

## BUSINESS SEGMENTS

Manufacturing of Generic APIs, Nutraceutical ingredients and Custom Synthesis of APIs for Big Pharma

Generic API Custom Synthesis Nutraceuticals

Leading manufacturer of Generic APIs in the world, currently offering 30 products commercially.

###### Scale
* World's largest in 10+ generic APIs
* 30 commercial APIs, 6 in R&D
* Manufactures 10s–1000s tons annually

###### Capabilities
* Complete backward integration
* Large batch sizes
* Dedicated production blocks

[More Details][41]

Your trusted CDMO and peptides partner for the last 25 years.

###### VALUE PROPOSITION
* 12 of top 20 Big Pharma for 10+ years
* Green chemistry principles
* Confidentiality and IP integrity
* Long-term trusted partnerships

###### Our Offerings
* Small molecules
* High potent
* Peptides
* Biological buffers

[More Details][42]

Supplies a full range of Carotenoids & market targeted Vitamins to the nutritional, pharma,
food/beverage & feed industries.

###### Diverse Portfolio
* Full carotenoid range
* Astaxanthin, beta carotene, lycopene
* Liquid, beadlet, powder formats
* Customized ingredient solutions

###### R&D & Support
* In-house R&D lab
* Application testing facility
* Customer formulation support
* Continuous innovation focus

[More Details][43]


## BUSINESS OPERATIONS

Discover the Divi’s Difference

###### Research & Development

Our 700+ scientists across four R&D centers develop commercially viable processes that remain
cost-effective throughout the product lifecycle, while continually optimising processes for custom
synthesis projects.

###### Manufacturing

Our three expansive manufacturing units, including the newly established Unit 3 facility, offer a
combined annual production capacity of more than 18,600 M3, facilitating a reliable global supply.

###### Quality

A team of over 2,500 analysts in Quality Control and Quality Assurance, along with state-of-the-art
testing equipment and monitoring systems, helps us ensure uniform quality across the globe.

services are becoming automated and the human touch is taken away, individuals like Adam who do
their job with dignity and diligence should be appreciated.”

01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

An Overview

Torrent Pharma, the flagship Company of Torrent Group, with a turnover of Rs 13,980 crores (FY2026)
is one of the leading Pharma companies in the Country. We are the pioneers in initiating the concept
of niche marketing in India and today are ranked amongst the leaders in therapeutic segment of
cardiovascular (CV), central nervous system (CNS), gastro-intestinal (GI), women healthcare (WHC),
Vitamins Minerals & Nutrients (VMN) and Cosmo-Dermatology. The Company also has significant presence
in diabetology, pain management, gynaecology, oncology and anti-infective segments. Torrent Pharma
has crossed many geographical boundaries with presence in more than 50 countries. The Company is
ranked first amongst Indian Companies for having largest market share in Brazil and Germany.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

## to create healthier futures.

# Trust us to move your cargo no matter where you need to go.

There’s no better choice than ASF for your global shipments. Our dedicated global team enables us to
offer favorable rates, timely market intelligence and industry trends that help optimize supply
chain performance.

[Book Your Route][35]

### We make shipping logistics easy for any industry.

Individualized care and deep industry knowledge builds the supply chain consistency you can depend
on.

[Ship Your Goods][36]
* ##### Retail
  
  Our retail shipping expertise saves you time and money.
* ##### Furniture & Housewares
  
  From the factory to your door, reliable delivery of any size.

  Industrial shipments handled with care and precision.
* ##### Food & Beverage
  
  Reliable shipping for perishable items to ensure freshness.
* ##### Manufacturing
  
  Services that ensure your supply chain runs smoothly.
* ##### Raw Materials
  
  We’ll help you navigate complex global raw material regulations.

[**Learn more**][40]

Why Texas

## The Future is Texas

If Texas were a country, its economy would rank the 8th largest in the world. “Chief Executive
Magazine” has ranked Texas “the #1 state for business” for 22 consecutive years. Forecasters rank
Texas first in the nation for five-year growth projections. The economic data tells a clear story:
Texas keeps raising the bar to offer unrivaled business opportunities. Experts give our state a
strong ranking in terms of business climate, GDP, job creation, population growth, and business
facilities.
[Lady writing on a whiteboard in workplace in Texas][Lady writing on a whiteboard in workplace in
Texas]
Why Texas

## A Competitive, Skilled Workforce

Texas boasts a highly capable, powerful, and influential civilian workforce of over 15 million,
making a significant impact across diverse industries. In fact, there are more Texans working than
the entire population of 46 states.
[Talented scientists testing in laboratory in Texas][Talented scientists testing in laboratory in
Texas]
Why Texas

## Powerhouse of a Talent Pipeline

Texas has among the highest completion rates and 148 higher ed institutions keep the talent pipeline
full and qualified.
[Hong Kong ship in Houston, Texas port at dusk][Hong Kong ship in Houston, Texas port at dusk]
Why Texas

## Multimodal Access to the World

Investment in a dynamic ground transportation network, water ports, rail and air service have made
Texas the #1 exporter for 22 consecutive years.
[Man looking out at a Texas lake while sitting on a blanket on a rock face shore][Man looking out at
a Texas lake while sitting on a blanket on a rock face shore]
Why Texas

## Quality of Life

More people are moving to Texas than any other state to tap into low costs, high value and diverse
living options. There's simply no place in the world that's quite like Texas.

# The Right Combinations to Overcome
# Immune Resistance in Cancer

### We are advancing next-generation combination therapies to elevate what’s possible for people
### living with cancer.

[Learn More][42]
[ " ][43]

##### Immuno-Oncology

We are focused on advancing a diversified portfolio of next-generation immuno-oncology therapies to
transform cancer treatment and extend survival for patients living with cancer.

[Learn More][44]
[LOQTORZI]

##### Anti-PD-1 Monoclonal Antibody

LOQTORZI® (toripalimab-tpzi) is the only available FDA-approved therapy for the treatment of
recurrent, locally advanced or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) in combination with
chemotherapy or as a single agent.

[Learn More][45]
Our Programs

### Developing a Portfolio of Immuno-Oncology Drugs to Improve Patient Outcomes

Our pipeline includes multiple clinical stage immuno-oncology drug candidates that target the tumor
microenvironment.

[View Our Pipeline][46]
Our Clinical Trials

### Testing the Safety and Effectiveness of Our I-O Drug Candidates

We have multiple ongoing clinical trials across a range of cancer indications assessing our
investigational immuno-oncology therapeutics.

[See Clinical Trials][47]

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

# The WMS Protecting 3PL Margins

Extensiv is the gold-standard WMS built on 20 years of real operational data.

[ See how it works ][96]
 

## For 3PLs who need to operate smarter, grow faster, and protect their margins, Extensiv is the
## gold-standard WMS.

Because we've been the backbone of 3PL operations longer than anyone, we hold the deepest
operational data in the industry, and that data is what makes AI and tools work in our customers’
unique facilities. The result isn’t just software that manages your warehouse. It’s intelligence
that runs it: smarter, faster, and at a lower cost.
3PL Built Powered By Data Relentlessly Customer-focused Margin is the Measure

**[ottawa_logistics_3pl_warehousing_cover]We've powered 3PL warehouses longer than anyone. **That
experience isn't just history, it's a competitive data and visibility advantage for you and your
team.

**[Warehouse Analytics - Benefits, Tools & Challenges]**

**Everyone's adding AI. But AI is only as good as its data. **Ours comes from the operational core
of your warehouse, not a third-party feed, not a spreadsheet, not a guess.

**[AdobeStock_325999637]Your customers expect more every year.** We obsess over giving you the tools
to exceed those expectations – through accurate pricing, optimal staffing, flawless fulfillment – so
you never lose a client to a missed promise.

 

**[AdobeStock_355811661-1]Thin margins leave no room for error.** Two decades of operational data,
AI built on it, and an obsession with your customers all point to one outcome: precision that
protects every point of margin and profit.

 

## 3PLs Solving Warehouse Challenges with Extensiv


### How APS Fulfillment Generated $250k of New Business in a Single Quarter

**Challenge:** Manual processes and disconnected systems limited scalability

**Solution:** Extensiv WMS automated operations, enabling faster fulfillment

**Results:**
1. $250K in new business
2. 97% decrease in order processing time
3. $40K saved in integration costs

[**READ THE FULL STORY**][97]

 

[aps product page case study photo]

#### **Extensiv is the backbone for running our business. It creates huge efficiency in our
#### workflows.** - Jack Lombardi, Director of Business Development, APS

### How Averitt Express Cut Labor Costs by 25%

**Challenge:** Stuck in manual processes and spreadsheets, making it difficult to track key metrics,
optimize staffing, and price contracts effectively

**Solution: **Extensiv’s WMS, SmartScan, and Labor Analytics to streamline operations, improve
accuracy, optimize staffing, and make data-driven pricing decision

**Results:**
1. 25% reduction in labor costs
2. 60 picking hours saved per day
3. Increased customer satisfaction

[**READ THE FULL STORY**][98]

 

[product page case study photo averitt]

#### **The impressive time savings we see are a major swing for us. They’ve all been created by
#### using Labor Analytics to say, ‘we can do more here, we can adjust here, we can increase
#### efficiencies there.** - Cody Smith, Distribution and Fulfillment Operations Leader

### How Quality Distribution Doubled its Customer Base

**Challenge:** Legacy system and manual processes made scaling and meeting modern demands
unsustainable

**Solution:** Used Extensiv to automate tasks, boost visibility, and build scalable, repeatable
workflows

**Results:**
1. Grew revenue 35% year over year
2. Reduced labor requirements by 60%
3. Doubled customer base

**[SEE HOW THEY DID IT][99]**

 

[quality distribution]

#### ** Extensiv has the tools, the team, and the resources so that as we grow and the demand
#### increases in different areas with technology, they’ll be there to point us in the right
#### direction and make sure we keep improving our performance and delivering the values our
#### customers care about.** - Steve Bohin, CEO

### How Fulfillmate Transformed Chaos into Scalable Growth

**Fulfillmate** was a small 3PL using spreadsheets and printed labels to ship a few hundred orders a
week.

As demand grew to **15,000+ weekly orders across multiple warehouses**, manual systems couldn’t keep
up. Clients needed faster shipping and better visibility.

By **adopting** **Extensiv’s warehouse and network tools**, Fulfillmate automated fulfillment,
reduced errors, and scaled fast without heavy infrastructure costs.

They **expanded into Canada, the UK, EU, and Australia**, and **increased order volume from existing
clients by 10%** in just 1**8 months**.

[**SEE FULL STORY**][100]

#### ** Extensiv’s support and shared vision has enabled us to grow much faster than we ever could

**Challenge: **Limited analog processes, lack of insight and picking/packing mistakes created a

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only

* ### Signals incumbent tools miss

  [Min Chi]
  Min ChiSenior Manager, Insights, Public SaaS Company
* ### Future focused insights
  
  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

## Email Finder FAQ

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

## Global Market Transformation

In a recent feature published by ODT Magazine, Husnu Ceylan shared his perspective on the
transformation of the global orthobiologics market and the increasingly strategic role these
solutions play in modern orthopedic care. During the interview, Ceylan highlighted that market
growth is being driven by a convergence of demographic, clinical, and structural factors, but most
importantly by a shift in surgical thinking. Today, surgeons are not only focused on mechanical
stabilization, but are increasingly seeking biological solutions that enhance healing, improve
functional outcomes, and deliver greater long-term clinical predictability. As Ceylan noted, the
growth of orthobiologics is not simply about increasing procedure volumes, but about the evolution
of surgical care itself, where biology is becoming an essential component of standard orthopedic and
spine treatment. The feature also underscores how orthobiologics have evolved beyond a niche segment
to become increasingly integrated across spine, trauma, sports medicine, and complex reconstruction
procedures, reinforcing their role as one of the fastest-evolving areas in musculoskeletal care.
Read the full article here: Au Naturel: How Orthobiologics Are Reshaping Care

## Global Market Transformation

In a recent feature published by ODT Magazine, Husnu Ceylan shared his perspective on the
transformation of the global orthobiologics market and the increasingly strategic role these
solutions play in modern orthopedic care. During the interview, Ceylan highlighted that market
growth is being driven by a convergence of demographic, clinical, and structural factors, but most
importantly by a shift in surgical thinking. Today, surgeons are not only focused on mechanical
stabilization, but are increasingly seeking biological solutions that enhance healing, improve
functional outcomes, and deliver greater long-term clinical predictability. As Ceylan noted, the
growth of orthobiologics is not simply about increasing procedure volumes, but about the evolution
of surgical care itself, where biology is becoming an essential component of standard orthopedic and
spine treatment. The feature also underscores how orthobiologics have evolved beyond a niche segment
to become increasingly integrated across spine, trauma, sports medicine, and complex reconstruction
procedures, reinforcing their role as one of the fastest-evolving areas in musculoskeletal care.

# Integrated supply chain and mobility solutions provider

Our new icon modernizes our visual identity, reflecting the dynamic and innovative spirit of being
driven forward. Inspired by our ‘Igniting Success’ philosophy, the new brand identity reflects our
dedication to accelerating progress for customers and the broader ecosystem, with a promise to
exceed expectations and make a lasting impact. It is a visual story of our values, ambitions and a
purposeful narrative that constantly reminds us of our purpose and drives us towards the impact we
are here to make.

[Read More][198]

SUCCESS

We seamlessly integrate various tech-enabled logistics solutions for complex requirements. Our
‘Customer First’ approach helps us weave the strands of trust, transparency, safety,
customisation and optimisation that ensures efficiency in all our operations. Our reach and
scalability enable our customers to stay ahead of the competition. With these integrated offerings,
we ensure that our customers achieve what they truly deserve – **Success**.

## Solutions That Drive Progress

### Contract Logistics

Our overarching goal is to optimise the journey of all inputs and finished products, ensuring that
the entire supply chain process is efficient, reliable, and customer-centric. We strive to provide a
seamless experience for our customers

### Freight Forwarding’

We offer air and ocean freight forwarding services for imports and exports through a strong network
of global partnerships. Our proficiency in designing a wide range of technology-led freight
solutions in customs and cross-border compliance

### B2B Express

Over the years, we have been transforming the express logistics space through innovation,
problem-solving, and continuous collaboration with our partners and customers, making logistics
faster, safer and more human.

### Last Mile Delivery

Our comprehensive last mile delivery network enables us to deliver our customers’ products to even
the most remote locations, providing a seamless and convenient shopping experience for their
customers.

### Mobility Solutions

We offer comprehensive mobility services for individuals and enterprises across major cities in
India. Our primary focus is on providing safe and cost-effective transportation solutions while
ensuring a delightful experience

## eDeL-EAR

A user-friendly digital platform designed for our customers providing real-time visualization of
their carbon footprint and empowering them to transition towards green logistics.

[ Read More ][203]

## Green Logistics Ecosystem

Evolving from green last-mile cargo deliveries to a comprehensive suite of green logistics
solutions. Today, Edel is our green logistics ecosystem that empowers our customers to mitigate
emissions across their supply chain.

[ Read More ][204]

## Igniting Excellence
## With Technology

We believe that technology will lead and revolutionise logistics. With this belief, we integrate
technology as a part of our holistic supply chain solutions. We also have an incubator program where
we co-create future-ready tech-powered solutions with the Indian start-up ecosystem.

Technology, when applied to logistics, has been shaping and optimising the supply chain process.
With reduced response time, efficient solutions, end-to-end & real-time visibility, efficiency,
flexibility and insights, the businesses are able to make informed decisions and gain complete
control over their supply chains.

dedication to accelerating progress for customers and the broader ecosystem, with a promise to
exceed expectations and make a lasting impact. It is a visual story of our values, ambitions and a
purposeful narrative that constantly reminds us of our purpose and drives us towards the impact we
are here to make.

customisation and optimisation that ensures efficiency in all our operations. Our reach and
scalability enable our customers to stay ahead of the competition. With these integrated offerings,
we ensure that our customers achieve what they truly deserve – **Success**.

## Solutions That Drive Progress

### Contract Logistics

Our overarching goal is to optimise the journey of all inputs and finished products, ensuring that
the entire supply chain process is efficient, reliable, and customer-centric. We strive to provide a
seamless experience for our customers

### Freight Forwarding’

We offer air and ocean freight forwarding services for imports and exports through a strong network
of global partnerships. Our proficiency in designing a wide range of technology-led freight
solutions in customs and cross-border compliance

### B2B Express

Over the years, we have been transforming the express logistics space through innovation,
problem-solving, and continuous collaboration with our partners and customers, making logistics
faster, safer and more human.

### Last Mile Delivery

Our comprehensive last mile delivery network enables us to deliver our customers’ products to even
the most remote locations, providing a seamless and convenient shopping experience for their
customers.

### Mobility Solutions

We offer comprehensive mobility services for individuals and enterprises across major cities in
India. Our primary focus is on providing safe and cost-effective transportation solutions while
ensuring a delightful experience

## eDeL-EAR

A user-friendly digital platform designed for our customers providing real-time visualization of
their carbon footprint and empowering them to transition towards green logistics.

## Green Logistics Ecosystem

Evolving from green last-mile cargo deliveries to a comprehensive suite of green logistics
solutions. Today, Edel is our green logistics ecosystem that empowers our customers to mitigate
emissions across their supply chain.

[ Read More ][204]

## Igniting Excellence
## With Technology

We believe that technology will lead and revolutionise logistics. With this belief, we integrate
technology as a part of our holistic supply chain solutions. We also have an incubator program where
we co-create future-ready tech-powered solutions with the Indian start-up ecosystem.

Technology, when applied to logistics, has been shaping and optimising the supply chain process.
With reduced response time, efficient solutions, end-to-end & real-time visibility, efficiency,
flexibility and insights, the businesses are able to make informed decisions and gain complete
control over their supply chains.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Pharmacy Services ][128]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Read More ][133]

Complete software solutions for pharmacies and hospitals worldwide. One-time purchase, lifetime
value.

## PharmaPOS

Pharmacy Management System

Complete POS solution for pharmacies. Manage inventory, process sales, track prescriptions, and
integrate mobile money payments.

Point of Sale & Inventory
Mobile Money Integration
Multi-Branch Support

Hospital Management System

Complete operating system for hospitals. Manage 25+ departments, from OPD to ICU, with real-time
patient flow tracking.

25+ Integrated Modules
Patient Queue Management
Lab & Radiology Integration
11+ User Roles & Permissions

## Why Healthcare Providers Choose Us

Trusted by thousands of pharmacies and hospitals worldwide.

### Windows & Mac

Runs seamlessly on both Windows and Mac computers. Choose your preferred platform.

### Easy Installation

Quick setup in minutes. Simple installation process with step-by-step guidance.

### Offline & Online

Works offline without internet and syncs when online. Uninterrupted operations guaranteed.

### Built for Global Healthcare

Multi-currency, mobile money integration, and support for 6+ languages to serve diverse markets.

Integrated Payment Solutions

MTN
MTN MoMo
Vodafone

## Powerful Features for Every Healthcare Need

From pharmacy management to complete hospital operations, we have you covered.

### Point of Sale

Fast checkout with barcode scanning, multi-unit pricing, and receipt printing.

### Mobile Money

Accept MTN, Vodafone, Airtel, M-Pesa, Orange Money, Wave, and more.

### Inventory

Track stock levels, expiry dates, batch numbers, and get low-stock alerts.

### Patient Management

Comprehensive patient records, visit history, vitals tracking, and NHIS integration.

### Lab & Radiology

Integrated lab tests, imaging requests, results tracking, and report generation.

### Analytics

Sales trends, staff performance, inventory valuation, and expense tracking.

### Multi-Branch

Connect multiple workstations and branches with real-time sync.

### User Roles

Admin, Pharmacist, Cashier, and Storekeeper roles with access control.

The Difference

BEFORE

* Paper records prone to loss and errors

* Credit customers hard to track
* Staff errors and potential theft undetected

* Digital records with automatic cloud backup

# Your Trusted
# Oncology Pharmacy

[LEARN MORE][37]

[][38] [][39]



**A Diagnosis Unlike Any Other**

**Deserves a Pharmacy Unlike Any Other**

 

As a specialty pharmacy that is 100% focused on oncology, our mission is to improve the lives of
patients battling cancer. We have robust access to limited distribution oncology medications along
with personalized services such as financial assistance sourcing, expert clinical counseling,
insurance benefit verification, and digital support. We are an oncology specialty pharmacy with
Board-Certified Oncology Pharmacists and nurses with specialized teams to guide patients with
compassion and care along their cancer journey.

At our core, we are a team of passionate individuals dedicated to advancing the field of
regenerative medicine. Our mission is to harness the power of nature to help patients heal faster
and more effectively than ever before. Through cutting-edge techniques and rigorous scientific
study, we create human perinatal-derived products that support the body’s natural healing processes.
Our goal is to provide the most innovative and effective solutions possible, improving patients’
lives and helping them achieve optimal health and wellness.

## Our Process & Procurement

[Pregnant woman icon representing perinatal tissue source for regenerative biologics.][Pregnant
woman icon representing perinatal tissue source for regenerative biologics.]

### Prescreening

Platinum Biologics products are obtained from healthy, carefully screened mothers at the time of
normal delivery. In addition to a stringent social screening interview, all mothers undergo serology
testing to ensure there is no risk for a communicable disease. No harm is brought to the mother or
her newborn and parents still have the option of storing the cord blood if desired.

[DNA helix icon representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.][DNA helix icon
representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.]

### Processing

Recovery of tissue is performed at the time of delivery by trained technicians in a sterile
environment. All processing is done in a cGMP facility following the regulations of the FDA and the
guidelines of the American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB) and the American Association of Blood
Banks (AABB).

[Validated shipping containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.][Validated shipping
containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.]

### Distribution

All Platinum Biologics products are shipped on dry ice in validated shipping containers to ensure
appropriate temperature is maintained.

[ Learn More ][16]

Platinum Biologics products are manufactured in state-of-the-art ISO Class cleanrooms. All equipment
is calibrated and validated to ensure consistent results are produced. Our facility is
FDA-registered and a multi-state licensed tissue bank providing high-quality natural biologics to
clinicians nationwide. We work closely with our partners to enhance their practice with the tools
and training necessary to implement natural biologics into their standard of care.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics is a wellness-focused company that offers nutritional supplements, biologic
formulations, and innovative health products designed to support a variety of wellness goals.
What types of products does Platinum Biologics offer?
Platinum Biologics provides dietary supplements, biologic products, wellness formulations, and
specialty health solutions featuring a range of nutritional and functional ingredients.
What are biologics?
Biologics are products derived from biological sources or developed using biological processes and
are commonly researched and utilized in health, wellness, and scientific fields.
What is the focus of Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics focuses on developing innovative wellness products that combine science-based
ingredients with modern formulation technologies.
What ingredients are commonly found in Platinum Biologics products?
Depending on the product, ingredients may include collagen, amino acids, antioxidants, botanical
extracts, peptides, vitamins, minerals, and other wellness-supporting compounds.
What is collagen and why is it important?
Collagen is a structural protein naturally present in the body that supports connective tissues,
skin, joints, and overall structural integrity.
What are antioxidants?
Antioxidants are compounds that help protect cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals and
support normal cellular function.
What role do amino acids play in wellness products?
Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins and are involved in numerous biological processes
related to metabolism, tissue maintenance, and cellular function.
Are Platinum Biologics products manufactured under quality standards?
Reputable supplement manufacturers typically follow quality control practices and manufacturing
standards to help ensure product consistency and reliability.
Who can benefit from wellness supplements?
Wellness supplements are often used by individuals seeking nutritional support, active lifestyle
products, and complementary additions to their overall health routines.
Does Platinum Biologics offer innovative delivery technologies?
Platinum Biologics products may utilize advanced formulation approaches designed to improve
convenience, ingredient stability, and product effectiveness.
Why is ingredient transparency important when choosing supplements?
Ingredient transparency helps consumers understand what is included in a product and allows them to
make informed purchasing decisions based on their wellness goals.
How can customers choose the right Platinum Biologics product?
Customers can compare ingredients, formulation types, product descriptions, wellness objectives, and
usage recommendations when selecting a product.
Where can consumers purchase Platinum Biologics products?
Consumers can browse and purchase available products directly through the Platinum Biologics website
and authorized distribution channels.
Why choose Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics offers wellness-focused formulations, science-driven product development, quality
ingredients, and a diverse portfolio of products designed to support modern health and wellness
lifestyles.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics is a wellness-focused company that offers nutritional supplements, biologic
formulations, and innovative health products designed to support a variety of wellness goals.
What types of products does Platinum Biologics offer?
Platinum Biologics provides dietary supplements, biologic products, wellness formulations, and
specialty health solutions featuring a range of nutritional and functional ingredients.
What are biologics?
Biologics are products derived from biological sources or developed using biological processes and
are commonly researched and utilized in health, wellness, and scientific fields.
What is the focus of Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics focuses on developing innovative wellness products that combine science-based
ingredients with modern formulation technologies.
What ingredients are commonly found in Platinum Biologics products?
Depending on the product, ingredients may include collagen, amino acids, antioxidants, botanical
extracts, peptides, vitamins, minerals, and other wellness-supporting compounds.
What is collagen and why is it important?
Collagen is a structural protein naturally present in the body that supports connective tissues,
skin, joints, and overall structural integrity.
What are antioxidants?
Antioxidants are compounds that help protect cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals and
support normal cellular function.
What role do amino acids play in wellness products?
Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins and are involved in numerous biological processes
related to metabolism, tissue maintenance, and cellular function.
Are Platinum Biologics products manufactured under quality standards?
Reputable supplement manufacturers typically follow quality control practices and manufacturing
standards to help ensure product consistency and reliability.
Who can benefit from wellness supplements?
Wellness supplements are often used by individuals seeking nutritional support, active lifestyle
products, and complementary additions to their overall health routines.
Does Platinum Biologics offer innovative delivery technologies?
Platinum Biologics products may utilize advanced formulation approaches designed to improve
convenience, ingredient stability, and product effectiveness.
Why is ingredient transparency important when choosing supplements?
Ingredient transparency helps consumers understand what is included in a product and allows them to
make informed purchasing decisions based on their wellness goals.
How can customers choose the right Platinum Biologics product?
Customers can compare ingredients, formulation types, product descriptions, wellness objectives, and
usage recommendations when selecting a product.
Where can consumers purchase Platinum Biologics products?
Consumers can browse and purchase available products directly through the Platinum Biologics website
and authorized distribution channels.
Why choose Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics offers wellness-focused formulations, science-driven product development, quality
ingredients, and a diverse portfolio of products designed to support modern health and wellness
lifestyles.

Club News
[Lily Wolff - New Works Associate - Chautauqua Theater Company][37]
[Lily Wolff - New Works Associate - Chautauqua Theater Company][38]
Jim Smith was called upon to introduce the speaker. Traditionally July is Chautauqua Program
presentations – started by John Hamilton. Later this month our Rotary scholarship winner, Joanna
Wang, University of Michigan violinist will be speaking and performing the last Monday of July.
 
Today we welcome Lily Wolff, in her second year as New Works Associate, her third year at
Chautauqua. She is a director by trade specializing in new plays by living writers, but also
practice creative producing, dramaturgy, and arts administration.

 
[Read more...][39]
[Angelo Marra, owner of West Main Mercantile][40]
[Angelo Marra, owner of West Main Mercantile][41]
Michelle introduced Angelo Marra, owner of West Main Mercantile, a retail store located in Falconer,
NY. The business supports over 60 small local businesses, artisans, retirees, and handcrafters. It
is your one stop shop for handmade jewelry, handbags, clothing, home décor and gifts and includes an
amazing selection of handmade candles, soaps, chocolate, candies, honey and maple syrup.
[Read more...][42]
[Dena Garfield - founder of Equine Union International][43]
[Dena Garfield - founder of Equine Union International][44]
Marion Beckerink introduced today’s speaker Dena Garfield, the founder of Equine Union
International, who believes that some of the most important leadership lessons don’t come from
boardrooms – they come from paying attention to what makes us human.
 
A life-long equestrian from the age of eight, a certified yoga instructor, meditation practitioner,
and community storyteller, Dena’s work brings together leadership, nervous system science, equine
wisdom, and human connection.
 
[Read more...][45]

Club News
[Lily Wolff - New Works Associate - Chautauqua Theater Company][37]
[Lily Wolff - New Works Associate - Chautauqua Theater Company][38]
Jim Smith was called upon to introduce the speaker. Traditionally July is Chautauqua Program
presentations – started by John Hamilton. Later this month our Rotary scholarship winner, Joanna
Wang, University of Michigan violinist will be speaking and performing the last Monday of July.
 
Today we welcome Lily Wolff, in her second year as New Works Associate, her third year at
Chautauqua. She is a director by trade specializing in new plays by living writers, but also
practice creative producing, dramaturgy, and arts administration.

 
[Read more...][39]
[Angelo Marra, owner of West Main Mercantile][40]
[Angelo Marra, owner of West Main Mercantile][41]
Michelle introduced Angelo Marra, owner of West Main Mercantile, a retail store located in Falconer,
NY. The business supports over 60 small local businesses, artisans, retirees, and handcrafters. It
is your one stop shop for handmade jewelry, handbags, clothing, home décor and gifts and includes an
amazing selection of handmade candles, soaps, chocolate, candies, honey and maple syrup.
[Read more...][42]
[Dena Garfield - founder of Equine Union International][43]
[Dena Garfield - founder of Equine Union International][44]
Marion Beckerink introduced today’s speaker Dena Garfield, the founder of Equine Union
International, who believes that some of the most important leadership lessons don’t come from
boardrooms – they come from paying attention to what makes us human.
 
A life-long equestrian from the age of eight, a certified yoga instructor, meditation practitioner,
and community storyteller, Dena’s work brings together leadership, nervous system science, equine
wisdom, and human connection.
 
[Read more...][45]

### A Partner with Purpose

When we partner, your goals become our goals.
We listen and bring specialized experts together when and
where you need them to support your teams and
immediately add value increasing confidence at each

Our AI-powered innovations enhance performance across your enterprise, connecting and harmonizing

## FEATURED SOLUTIONS

## **Deep Expertise**

### Oncology

Our therapeutic expertise in oncology and hematology runs deep and wide, having helped develop or
commercialize 96% of novel oncology drugs approved by the FDA and 93% of oncology products granted
marketing authorization by the EMA in the last five years. Our unique lab-to-life service offering
extends from preclinical to clinical development and regulatory to full commercialization and
marketing capabilities.

We’re passionate about collaborating for a cure.

[Learn More][143]

### Predictive Commercial Solutions

We combine a deep understanding of human behavior and the latest technologies with the hard-earned
knowledge and insights that come from supporting the commercialization of more products than any
other partner. Then we deliver predictive solutions that reduce risk, accelerate commercial
performance and fulfill our industry’s promise to patients.

[Learn More][144]

### FSP Solutions

Syneos Health FSP 360 provides a customized approach that prioritizes flexibility and
fit-for-purpose solutions, easing the burden of resource management and functional delivery while
enabling sponsor visibility and control of clinical development. Every customer is unique. We
believe every FSP solutions should be, too.

[Learn More][145]

Our therapeutic expertise in oncology and hematology runs deep and wide, having helped develop or
commercialize 96% of novel oncology drugs approved by the FDA and 93% of oncology products granted
marketing authorization by the EMA in the last five years. Our unique lab-to-life service offering

marketing capabilities.

## Empowering Healthcare with Strategic Solutions

Access complete healthcare market research, with detailed analysis and insights to empower
businesses & make data-driven decisions.

Search

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

Detailed information of company and industry profiles, financial data, investment insights, business
periodicals, Mergers and Acquisitions along with the SWOT analysis.

### Segmental Analysis

Complete analysis of all the segments covered in the report, with their market dynamics to get an
overall understanding of the current market scenario.

### Market Share Analysis (MSA)

Evaluating competitive marketing effectiveness through Market Share Analysis (MSA) to gain a
complete sense of specific market that will impact your revenue.

## From our Clients

### "Comprehensive Market Research"

We trust Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting for in-depth market research. Their subscription
data is essential for our decision-making.

The Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting support team is exceptional. Their insights are
consistently timely, relevant, and highly dependable.

insights are precise and invaluable.

[ > Explore our Science ][13]

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
During its June 18, 2026 webcast, TransCode Therapeutics shared strategic, scientific, and clinical
updates, highlighted by the initiation of its Phase 2a clinical trial of TTX-MC138 and supported by
continued progress across its broader investment thesis.                                           
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## **Lead Therapeutic Candidate - TTX-MC138**

## **Targeting microRNA-10b - master regulator of metastasis**

TransCode’s lead therapeutic candidate, TTX-MC138, is a targeted therapy designed to treat cancer
patients with metastatic cancer, an area traditionally overlooked because, from a therapeutic
perspective, non-metastatic and metastatic tumor cells are often viewed as being the same. However,
despite significant efforts made in the past several years to decipher the genetic structure of
primary tumors, there has been relatively limited attention given to comprehending the genetic
makeup of metastatic tumors.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬───
* Small, non-coding strands of RNA (microRNAs) have been identified as a significant player in  │[Pi
  the pathology of cancer and metastasis                                                        │ctu
* Our research observed that miRNA-10b acts as a **master regulator of the viability of         │re]
  metastatic tumor cells**                                                                      │   
* miRNA-10b is shown to be largely dispensable for normal development but critical to           │   
  tumorigenesis                                                                                 │   
* Our competitive advantage derives from years of work to deliver oligonucleotides (synthetic   │   
  RNA)  to cancer cells, a decades long challenge in the market                                 │   
* The iron oxide nanoparticle delivery platform, TTX, is highly tunable to pre-designed         │   
  specifications to deliver therapeutic candidates to targets in tumors and metastases          │   
* Treatment with TTX-MC138 has led to durable regression of established metastases in murine    │   
  models of metastatic breast cancer and pancreatic cancer                                      │   
* miRNA-10b has been shown to have broad applicability across over 18 + cancer types  including │   
  breast, pancreatic, ovarian and colon cancer, glioblastomas and others                        │   
* TTX-MC138 is hormone receptor independent and has the potential to treat metastatic breast    │   
  cancer regardless of type (ER+/-, PR+/, HER2+/-, or combinations thereof)                     │   
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴───

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**TransCode's promising therapeutic strategy relies on specific eradication of metastatic tumor   
cells– cells that have evolved from the primary tumor to escape into the circulation, survive     
during transit, and colonize distant organs.                                                      
TTX-MC138, our lead therapeutic candidate,  has been shown to inhibit microRNA-10b                
resulting in regression of disease without recurrence in pre-clinical**** studies.**              
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[ Read More - TTX-MC138 ][14]

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
*TTX is an investigational platform encompassing therapeutic candidates (including TTX-MC138) and 
diagnostics which remain in development. Their safety and efficacy have not yet been evaluated by 
the FDA or any other regulatory agency.*                                                          
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────

## Who we are

At Shorla Oncology we develop and commercialize innovative oncology drugs. We focus on indications
where existing treatments are limited, in shortage or inadequate for the target population.

Our products are the result of Shorla’s world class team encompassing thought leaders, clinicians,
scientists and commercial strategists who have extensive experience in the area of drug development
and commercialization of niche cancer treatments.

Our growing portfolio will bring accessible, affordable and life-changing treatments to patients,

# Shorla Oncology: The Heart of Innovation

## Who we are

At Shorla Oncology we develop and commercialize innovative oncology drugs. We focus on indications
where existing treatments are limited, in shortage or inadequate for the target population.

Our products are the result of Shorla’s world class team encompassing thought leaders, clinicians,
scientists and commercial strategists who have extensive experience in the area of drug development
and commercialization of niche cancer treatments.

Our growing portfolio will bring accessible, affordable and life-changing treatments to patients,
delivering a major contribution to patient care.
